evidence.t: Unnamed lake, 1.4 ha, 90 m from the road.
Beside a river: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 531 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-6, Region 4 Kootenay.
Private land 100 m SW: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).
Hwy 3A 340 m NE: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).
Inside CRESTON VALLEY WILDLIFE MANAGEMENT AREA Wildlife Management Area: rules differ by area. Call the regional office before you hunt (synopsis page 9, 99%).

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-6: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).
Wolf: no closed season in MU 4-6 below 1,100 m (synopsis page 39 footnote, 90%: the Trench line is not mapped and "below 1,100 m" is my reading for both groups). VERIFY with the regional office.
